title: I Forwarded the Shared Google Calendar After My Ex Kept My Dentist

parts.text: I got a reminder at 8:04 a.m. for a cleaning I did not book. The event title was Jess enamel, located at my dentist, created by my ex, Tyler. We had split in June. The shared calendar was supposed to be empty except the dog's heartworm. I was thirty, copywriter, holding a mug and a push notification. Tyler had used my insurance phone number in the notes. I screenshot the event, the sharing settings, and the note. Then I forwarded the invite to Tyler with guest permissions removed and the dentist cc'd. At 8:11 the office called me to confirm Tyler's cleaning under my name.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: The office is confirming his cleaning under my name while I still share the dog calendar.

social.video_title: He booked my dentist on the dog calendar — Part 1/2
social.description: June split, enamel event, insurance in the notes. The office called me. Would you have let him sit in the chair?

parts.text: I told the office the name on the chart was mine and the appointment was not. They cancelled. I removed Tyler from the calendar and moved the dog to a new one. He texted that it was just a cleaning. A cleaning on my file is a file. He found a new dentist. I found a new sharing default: only me. The heartworm reminder still pings. Tyler does not. Enamel is not communal property.

social.description: Cancelled cleaning, new dog calendar, new default. Was an ex a dependent?
